hookText: WHOOP becomes Formula 1's official wearable, with WHOOP Live coming

beats.say: WHOOP announced a multi-year deal as Formula 1's Official Health & Fitness Wearable; selected driver data will appear in F1 broadcasts through WHOOP Live starting in 2027.
According to F1 coverage of the deal, selected physiological data on how racing affects drivers' bodies and minds will be integrated into broadcasts, alongside new storytelling with the sport.
In Formula 1, the car has thousands of sensors.
